st.t: Talk to the Mage of Zamorak in the Wilderness north of Edgeville. BRING NOTHING AS YOU CAN BE KILLED BY OTHER PLAYERS HERE.
Talk to the Mage of Zamorak in the Chaos Temple in south east Varrock.
s: Where do you get your runes from?
Maybe I could make it worth your while?
Yes, but I can still help you as well.
I did it so that I could then steal their secrets.
But I'm a loyal servant of Zamorak as well!
Okay, fine. I don't really serve Zamorak.
Because I can still help you.

s: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
